notes.title: Patch Note 2.0.2 for 27 March, 2024
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43307299/6be10f85d893541ef825178326020c278dedd012.png[/img]
[b]Announcement from the Goi: Spooky Run Team[/b]

The team has made improvements and addressed various issues as follows:

- Fixed bug homework page can not close when the connection lost.
- Fixed bug AI (Bozo) not respond to player traps.
- Fixed forcing game start (G button) to cause a countdown.

Add color to Ping status
- Green It indicates good connectivity providing a smooth experience.
- Yellow enough for playing
- Red indicates a slower connection and may cause delays

- Show status room
- New title screen
- System ui pop up change color
- Add Homework description 
- Fixed bug Homework reward
- Fixed minor bug

[b]Players must log out of Steam before updating[/b]
